verdict.reasons: Core defects prevent acceptance: 1. Technical evidence mismatch: The required continuous irrigation header with a threaded pressure gauge port and a small take-off fitting for the drip tape is not present. Instead, the image depicts a small gauge resting on the soil surface next to a tape line, which fails to demonstrate the specified installed plumbing context. 2. Packaging used as hardware: The white drip tape is visually emanating directly from the bottom of the commercial AFP carton, implying the packaging is being used as a source of supply for the installed lateral, which is a core geometry defect. 3. Branding text: The secondary text below the AFP logo (e.g., 'Ctip bririgatio Ta...') is incoherent gibberish, constituting a core branding defect beyond simple blur.
